mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which often precedes a downturn in economic activity and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE increases by > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a contraction in consumer demand, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS decreases by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a supply-side shock and a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by > 0.5% and UNRATE increases by > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressures, which can lead to tightening monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by > 2% year-over-year.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals a strengthening demand for housing, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases by > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) coupled with a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a tightening monetary policy in response to economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decreases by > 0.5% quarter-over-quarter and FEDFUNDS increases by > 0.25%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both conditions are met.
